evals.prompt: Build the investment confirmation step for the mobile app (Arabic). List the components.
evals.expected_output: A BottomSheet (showHandle, showHeader, showFooter, Direction=RTL) with SheetHeader «مراجعة الاستثمار» plus deal name subtitle, Sheet Content / Summary with KeyValue rows (amount, agency fee, expected net profit, نسبة صافي العائد المتوقع), Divider and a strong total, ComplianceBadge Type=Shariah, an unchecked Checkbox consent with a Link to the offering file, and SheetFooter Layout=Stacked with one primary Button «تأكيد الاستثمار» and a secondary «تعديل المبلغ»; states named.

Fees and expected net profit are visible before confirming and labelled متوقع
Names loading (Button State=loading or Skeleton) and error (Alert Tone=error inside the sheet) states
Amounts written with Western digits and currency after the amount

evals.prompt: What's the difference between StatusPill and Tag? When do I use each?
evals.expected_output: Tag labels a category or metadata (sector, document type, risk), display only, Tone x Size x Style; StatusPill labels a state or attribute outside the deal lifecycle (Verified, KYC complete, Pending review), Tone x Variant subtle/solid x Size sm/md x HasIcon, and is the delta chip in Stat; deal lifecycle statuses use IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor), removable chips Tag Removable, tier ribbons dealTags; Tag is unpublished.
expectations: Deciding question: category (Tag) vs state or attribute (StatusPill)
Says deal lifecycle statuses (Late, Funded, Defaulted) use IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor), not either
Mentions Tag Removable for removable chips and dealTags for deal image ribbons
Gives the correct variant properties for each (Tag: Tone, Size, Style filled/subtle; StatusPill: Tone, Variant subtle/solid, Size sm/md, HasIcon)
Flags that Tag is not in the published library while StatusPill is

evals.prompt: How do I show the funded percentage of a deal?

expectations: Recommends ProgressBar with Tone=brand
Uses the exact props showLabel, Label and Value and Direction=RTL in Figma
Mentions CardDeal already contains the progress bar for cards
States the value must be the real live percentage, never rounded up or used as pressure
Rejects MilestoneProgress, ProgressSegment or Slider for this

evals.expected_output: Lists CardDeal (3013:95390, published, organism) variants Layout=Hero/Row, State=Available/Reserved/Invested/Closed, Direction=RTL/LTR, booleans Qualified, Show media, Show status, Show highlights, Show ROI, Show arrow, Show success, Show Upper left arrow, instance swap Media image, with canonical code names, notes title/ROI/highlights live in nested CardDeal / Headline, Metric, Highlights atoms and that direction is not a code parameter.
